record.field:
Bridge an inbound call leg directly to an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent over TLS-encrypted SIP. The agent is addressed by its EL phone_number entity (el_virtual_number_uid), provisioned automatically when an extension is assigned to the agent (ADR-021). No FreeSWITCH gateway record is needed — the SIP URI is fully self-contained.
The FreeSWITCH channel UUID is forwarded as X-Call-Sid so EL echoes it back in the conversation_initiation / post_call webhooks, letting us tie the EL conversation to a specific connect.call row.
The SIP user-part is `agent_uid` itself: ElevenLabs routes inbound INVITEs by matching the `phone_number` field of the registered phone_number entity, which we provision as `agent_uid` in `_ensure_el_virtual_number`. Using the entity ID (phnum_…) yields SIP 404 UNALLOCATED_NUMBER. `el_virtual_number_uid` is only the control-plane handle for create/update/delete via EL's API.
Variables: extension_number - dialed Odoo extension (regex anchor) agent_uid - ElevenLabs agent_id (SIP user-part + X-Agent-Id header) el_virtual_number_uid - EL phone_number_id (phnum_…); kept for context, not used in URI

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Agent-Id={{ agent_uid }}"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Call-Sid=${uuid}"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="bridge" data="{absolute_codec_string='PCMU,PCMA'}sofia/external/sip:{{ agent_uid }}@sip.rtc.elevenlabs.io:5061;transport=tls"/> </condition> </extension>
